items.title: GTCR Weighs Buyout of Global Payments Days After Earlier Effort Ended
items.why: Processor ownership changes can shift acceptance and pricing, which affects co-brand card economics.
items.summary_ai: Private equity firm GTCR is exploring a buyout of payment processor Global Payments, with no decision made.
items.take: Processor ownership changes can shift acceptance and pricing, which affects co-brand card economics.
